key: And the believers should not all go out to fight. Of every troop of them, a party only should go forth, that they (who are left behind) may gain sound knowledge in religion, and that they may warn their folk when they return to them, so that they may beware.
s: In a chapter that commands fighting and condemns staying behind, the believers learn who must march; al-Tabari, on 9:122, takes the understanding as gained by the party that marches, not by those who stay, from seeing God’s victory for the believers.
src: al-Tabari, Jāmiʿ al-bayān, on 9:122, the Arabic text of the Tarteel QUL library via spa5k/tafsir_api, commit 9ae590a (2026)

evidence.words: فإن أولى الأقوال في ذلك بالصواب، قولُ من قال: ليتفقه الطائفة النافرة بما تعاين من نصر الله أهلَ دينه وأصحابَ رسوله، على أهل عداوته والكفر به … فإن قال قائل: وما تنكر أن يكون معناه: ليتفقه المتخلِّفون في الدين؟ قيل: ننكر ذلك لاستحالته.
evidence.gloss: The most correct of the views is that of whoever said: let the party that marches out gain understanding by what it witnesses of God’s giving victory to the people of His religion and the companions of His Messenger over those hostile to Him and disbelieving in Him ... If someone asks, why do you reject that it means ‘so that those who stay behind may gain understanding in religion’, the answer is: we reject it because it is impossible.

reason: The problem holds. Re-opened packet.js quran 22 --verse 9.122. The seg is labelled 9:121 to 9:122, but al-Tabari opens a separate heading for 9:121 (on spending and crossing valleys) and another for 9:122. The reading sits under the 9:122 heading: he prefers that the marching party gains understanding by witnessing God’s victory for the people of His religion, says this is the view of al-Hasan al-Basri, and rejects the stayers reading as impossible. So the place is now ‘on 9:122’ in both s and src, as on days 13 and 32. The evidence pieces are unchanged and verbatim in the packet; only their locator is updated. Commentator and reading are unchanged. verse.js ok (At-Tawbah 9:122, at 1356). entry-check ok.
